questions.q: The Mano-River Union was originally formed in 1973 as a customs union between which two West African countries?
questions.explain: The **Mano-River Union (MRU)** was established by the Mano River Declaration in 1973. It was originally formed by **Liberia** and **Sierra Leone**, with Guinea and Côte d'Ivoire joining later to promote economic cooperation.
